romanized_text:
arav aur riy ek hi skul men padhate the aur pakke dost the. ek din skul men vijnana mele ki ghoshan hui. arav bahut utsahit hokar riy ke pas daudaa aur bol, riya, hamen is bar kuch jabaradasta banan hai. agar ham jit gae to pure skul men hamar nam hog. riy ne hansate hue kaha, bilkula, chal aj se hi shuru karate hain.

donon ne milakar ek chot robot banane k phaisal kiya. lekin kuch hi dinon men mushkilen ane lagin. ek sham robot k sarkit bara-bara jal jata tha. arav jhunjhal kara bol, yaha kam hi nahin kara rah. mainne itani mehanat ki aur sab bekar j rah hai. riy ne use shant karate hue kaha, itana pareshan mat ho, ham phir se koshish karenge.

usi rat arav apani dadi ke pas gaya aur sari bat batai. dadi ghar ki sabase bujaurg sadasy thin. arav ne kaha, dadi, mujhe lagat hai main har jaung. dadi ne pyar se usak sir sahalay aur bolin, beta, dhairy rakho. mehanat kabhi bekar nahin jati. har asaphalat kuch sikhati hai. arav ko unaki bat se nai himmat mili.

agale din vijnana mele men adhyapak sharm sabhi pariyojanaon ki janch kara rahe the. ve apani sakhati ke lie jane jate the. unhonne arav se puch, tumane yaha robot kaise banay aur isak asali upayog kya hai? arav ne shanti se har saval k uttar diya. adhyapak sharm ne sir hilakar kaha, tumhari mehanat sapha dikhai deti hai.

parinam ki ghoshan hui aur arav tath riy ki tim pratham ai. riy khushi se chillai, hama jit gae! mujhe yakin hi nahin ho rah. arav ne hansate hue kaha, mainne kaha tha n, ham kamal kara denge. us sham donon doston ne apani jit k jashn manay aur dadi ko dhanyavad kaha jinaki baton ne unhen kabhi har nahin manane di.

key_events: Announcement of a science fair at the school
Arav excitedly approaches Riy and proposes to create an amazing project together
Riy laughs and agrees to start the project immediately
event_chain.scene_goal: Establish the partnership between Arav and Riy to work on a science fair project
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the previous event, Arav now proposes a project to Riy

key_events: Arav and Riy decide to build a small robot together
The robot repeatedly catches fire during testing
Riy calms Arav and promises to try again
event_chain.scene_goal: Show the initial failure of their project and Riy’s supportive response
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the partnership established, Arav now faces setbacks and Riy offers encouragement

key_events: Arav visits his grandmother and shares his concerns about the project
Grandmother advises Arav to stay patient, work hard, and learn from failures, giving him renewed confidence
event_chain.scene_goal: To provide emotional support and motivation for Arav after the project's initial failure
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the initial failure of their project and Riy’s supportive response, Arav now seeks guidance from his grandmother.

key_events: Professor Sharm inspects all project proposals
Professor Sharm asks Arav how he built the robot and its real use
Arav calmly answers all questions
Professor Sharm praises Arav’s hard work
event_chain.scene_goal: To provide Arav with encouragement and validation after the project's initial failure
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the project's initial failure, Arav now receives encouragement from Professor Sharm

key_events: Announcement of the result and Arav and Riy’s team being first
Riy exclaims joyfully, "We won!"
Arav laughs and says they will do great
That evening both friends celebrate their victory and thank their grandmother

event_chain.narrative_link: Following the encouragement after the project's initial failure, Arav now celebrates the success with Riy and thanks Dadi

neutral_script.dialogue:
Professor Sharm: Arav, tumne robot ka design kaise kiya aur iska asli use kya hai?  
Arav: Professor, maine sensor integration aur power management pe focus kiya, aur robot ko disaster response ke liye design kiya hai, jisse rescue teams ko real-time data mil sake.  
Professor Sharm: Bahut accha kaam kiya, Arav. Tumhari mehnat aur dedication clearly dikh rahi hai.
